device.basis: Unit at 0xfff7d000 of X-T20 2.11 section 6: the driver's stop 0x156704c writes 0 to +0x00 and polls +0x00 through 0x1567064 until it reads 1, and 0x156707c follows it. The unit is stopped inside the section-6 worker whose state block is 0x1a5c444 (0x1566d6c from 0x16b2aa4 and 0x1566f54 from 0x16b2adc); moving the auto mode selector lever to AUTO stops it (strict graph board, 2026-11-04). Its name and what it computes are unknown. The words read back their last write and start at 0; +0x00 bit 0 is the only status bit seen waited for and is declared idle. No interrupt, DMA or data is modeled.
